Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

knewsr 0.1.0

First release.

Input and collection

  • read_news() reads Excel, CSV/TSV (UTF-8 or CP949), JSON and JSONL news files, or a whole directory of them; read_bigkinds() is an alias for BigKinds exports.
  • as_news() converts any news data frame to one standard schema (doc_id, date, source, title, text, keyword). It detects common column names (BigKinds headers, headline, body, content, pubDate, press, …), parses many date formats element by element and warns about values it cannot parse, normalizes keyword separators and list columns, and can drop repeated articles (dedup = TRUE). It warns when no title, date or source column is found, naming the file when called from read_news(); pass NA for a field to leave it empty without a warning.
  • collect_naver() collects articles from the Naver News Search API.
  • collect_rss() collects articles from RSS 2.0 and Atom feeds.

Preprocessing

  • clean_news() removes bracketed headers, bylines and datelines, e-mail addresses, URLs and special characters.
  • stopwords_ko() returns a default Korean news stopword list.
  • tokenize_ko() builds a token table from keyword lists or, with RcppMeCab and MeCab-ko, from text; ngrams_ko() builds n-grams.

Analysis

  • count_terms(), tf_idf() and summarise_corpus().
  • as_dtm() and as_tdm() return sparse Matrix objects.
  • cooccurrence() counts co-occurrence within documents or token windows.
  • keyness() compares groups with the log-likelihood ratio (G2, default) or chi-square.
  • term_trend() counts terms per day, week or month.

Visualization

  • plot_terms(), plot_keyness(), plot_trend(), plot_wordcloud() and plot_network() return ggplot objects.
